The polynomial \( p(x) \) is monic of degree 4, so it can be written as \( p(x) = (x-1)(x-2)(x-3)(x-r) \), where \( r \) is the unknown fourth root.

Evaluate \( p(0) \):
\[ p(0) = (-1)(-2)(-3)(-r) = 6r. \]

Evaluate \( p(4) \):
\[ p(4) = (4-1)(4-2)(4-3)(4-r) = 3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1 \cdot (4-r) = 6(4-r) = 24 - 6r. \]

Add them together:
\[ p(0) + p(4) = 6r + (24 - 6r) = 24. \]

The sum is independent of the fourth root.

Answer: 24
